clips.title: The story
paras: South of Mystral Lake, Krolg lives uncorrupted in an isolated hut in Ashenvale. Cast out from the Foulweald tribe, he kept his sanity when his kin fell to demonic madness. He speaks only with those who appear to be furbolgs.

South of Mystral Lake, Krolg remains lucid and untouched by madness. Most Foulweald furbolgs in Ashenvale have succumbed to the demonic taint left by the Burning Legion. In his secluded shelter, Krolg keeps a cautious vigil over the forest. He witnessed his brethren descend into senseless violence, and now speaks only with beings who appear to be kin.
